uncertainties: Publisher-hosted masters were not found; archive scans/photos retain underlying rights and are not deployment permission.
Only the requested game runs at this skin; artwork does not change ROM/core or seat count.

The supplied photo documents one cathedral side decal, reused on both sides with readable lettering and corresponding placement; the opposite-side original print is not independently verified. Plain black surrounds the decal, not enlarged full-height artwork.
Red molding follows the supplied conversion/restoration cabinet, not a universal factory color claim. Existing archived marquee/bezel/deck remain the selected Atari operator kit.
Modeled buttons are two Rotate buttons per player; photographed start buttons remain in the overlay.
